class="RichText__Container-sc-39eba4fb-0 eendqC"><p>“Drunk In Love” was released along with “XO” as the lead singles for Beyoncé’s self-titled album. She once again recruits her husband <a href="https://genius.com/artists/Jay-z" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/artists/2">JAY-Z</a> to join the party as this marked the first collaboration from <a href="https://genius.com/artists/The-carters" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/artists/1408735">THE CARTERS</a> since 2013’s <a href="https://genius.com/Jay-z-part-ii-on-the-run-lyrics" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/songs/180511">“Part II (On the Run)”</a> continuation of their first collab <a href="https://genius.com/Jay-z-03-bonnie-and-clyde-lyrics" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/songs/3231">“‘03 Bonnie & Clyde”</a>.</p>

<p>“Drunk In Love” seems to be a more sexualized continuation of their first track together, <a href="https://genius.com/Beyonce-crazy-in-love-lyrics" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/songs/32167">“Crazy in Love.”</a> Over <a href="https://genius.com/2654562" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/referents/2654562">Detail’s blaring beat</a>, the lyrics repeatedly touch on female and marital sexuality, and the effects of alcohol.</p>

<p>Bey described her entire self-titled album as <a href="http://www.out.com/entertainment/music/2014/04/08/beyonc%C3%A9-liberated" rel="noopener nofollow">“much freer than anything I’d done in the past,”</a> but none seemed more free than “Drunk In Love” with its <a href="https://genius.com/2654562" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/referents/2654562">freestyled lyrics</a> and studio fun.</p>

<p><a href="https://genius.com/artists/Kanye-west" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/artists/72">Kanye West</a> hopped on the <a href="https://genius.com/Beyonce-drunk-in-love-remix-lyrics" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/songs/362852">official remix</a> featured on the platinum edition of the album, but the song’s influence stretched to several other remixes and covers from <a href="https://genius.com/The-weeknd-drunk-in-love-remix-lyrics" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/songs/363498">The Weeknd</a>, <a href="https://genius.com/Lil-wayne-drunk-in-love-lyrics" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/songs/685094">Lil Wayne</a>, <a href="https://genius.com/Beyonce-drunk-in-love-ti-remix-lyrics" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/songs/398032">T.I.</a>, <a href="https://genius.com/Ed-sheeran-drunk-in-love-1-1-lyrics/" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/songs/405779">Ed Sheeran</a>, and more.</p>

<p>Future also released a <a href="https://genius.com/Future-drunk-in-love-remix-lyrics" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/songs/351153">remix</a> to “Drunk in Love” after <a href="https://web.archive.org/web/20140809211630/http://www.mtv.com/news/1817123/future-drunk-in-love/" rel="noopener nofollow">claiming</a> he created a demo version with producer Detail to entice Beyoncé to use the track. Future would use his melody from the demo on his track <a href="https://genius.com/Future-good-morning-lyrics" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/songs/384719">“Good Morning”</a> before “Drunk in Love” was released several months later, causing Future to scrap “Good Morning” off his album <a href="https://genius.com/albums/Future/Honest" rel="noopener" data-api_path="/albums/1311540"><em>Honest</em></a>.</p>

<p>“Drunk in Love” peaked at #2 on the US <em>Billboard</em> Hot 100 chart, spending eight weeks in the top ten. At the <em>57th Grammy Awards</em>, “Drunk in Love” won Best R&B Song and Best R&B Performance. The single was a multi-platinum hit internationally, including a 6x platinum certification in the US, 4x platinum in Canada, 3x platinum in Australia and 2x platinum in the UK.</p>

<p>The song’s music video was directed by Hype Williams and shot in black-and-white in Golden Beach, Florida at a beach front manse. The visual features scenes of the pair singing the song together. The music video won Best Collaboration and was nominated for Video of the Year at the 2014 <em>MTV Video Music Awards</em>. Beyoncé talked about how the music video came together in a <a href="https://www.out.com/entertainment/music/2014/04/08/beyonc%C3%A9-liberated" rel="noopener nofollow">2014 interview</a> with <em>Out</em> magazine:</p>

<blockquote><p>We were in Miami for Jay’s concert, and it was just the two of us, on the beach, amazing weather, and one outfit! It’s beautiful in its simplicity. If you want something to feel real and urgent, you can’t overthink it.</p></blockquote>

She once again recruits her husband [JAY-Z](https://genius.com/artists/Jay-z) to join the party as this marked the first collaboration from [THE CARTERS](/artists/The-carters) since 2013\'s [\\\"Part II (On the Run)\\\"](genius.com/Jay-z-part-ii-on-the-run-lyrics) continuation of their first collab [\\\"\'03 Bonnie & Clyde\\\"](genius.com/Jay-z-03-bonnie-and-clyde-lyrics).\\n\\n\\\"Drunk In Love\\\" seems to be a more sexualized continuation of their first track together, [\\\"Crazy in Love.\\\"](genius.com/Beyonce-crazy-in-love-lyrics) Over [Detail\'s blaring beat](http://genius.com/2654562), the lyrics repeatedly touch on female and marital sexuality, and the effects of alcohol.\\n\\nBey described her entire self-titled album as [\\\"much freer than anything I’d done in the past,\\\"](http://www.out.com/entertainment/music/2014/04/08/beyonc%C3%A9-liberated) but none seemed more free than \\\"Drunk In Love\\\" with its [freestyled lyrics](http://genius.com/2654562) and studio fun.\\n\\n[Kanye West](/artists/Kanye-west) hopped on the [official remix](http://genius.com/Beyonce-drunk-in-love-remix-lyrics) featured on the platinum edition of the album, but the song\'s influence stretched to several other remixes and covers from [The Weeknd](http://genius.com/The-weeknd-drunk-in-love-remix-lyrics), [Lil Wayne](http://genius.com/Lil-wayne-drunk-in-love-lyrics), [T.I.](http://genius.com/Beyonce-drunk-in-love-ti-remix-lyrics), [Ed Sheeran](http://genius.com/Ed-sheeran-drunk-in-love-1-1-lyrics/), and more.\\n\\nFuture also released a [remix](http://genius.com/Future-drunk-in-love-remix-lyrics) to \\\"Drunk in Love\\\" after [claiming](https://web.archive.org/web/20140809211630/http://www.mtv.com/news/1817123/future-drunk-in-love/) he created a demo version with producer Detail to entice Beyoncé to use the track. Future would use his melody from the demo on his track [\\\"Good Morning\\\"](https://genius.com/Future-good-morning-lyrics) before \\\"Drunk in Love\\\" was released several months later, causing Future to scrap \\\"Good Morning\\\" off his album [*Honest*](https://genius.com/albums/Future/Honest).\\n\\n\\\"Drunk in Love\\\" peaked at #2 on the US *Billboard* Hot 100 chart, spending eight weeks in the top ten. At the *57th Grammy Awards*, \\\"Drunk in Love\\\" won Best R&B Song and Best R&B Performance. The single was a multi-platinum hit internationally, including a 6x platinum certification in the US, 4x platinum in Canada, 3x platinum in Australia and 2x platinum in the UK.\\n\\nThe song\'s music video was directed by Hype Williams and shot in black-and-white in Golden Beach, Florida at a beach front manse. The visual features scenes of the pair singing the song together. The music video won Best Collaboration and was nominated for Video of the Year at the 2014 *MTV Video Music Awards*.
